$comment: Official modules TiDev no longer supports. EDITED BY HAND - see docs/module-curation.md. An entry removes the module from the site: browse, its four pages, the sitemap and llms.txt. /registry/v1 keeps serving it, so an app that already depends on it still resolves. Six of these still ship a current Android release and are delisted anyway; each entry records what that costs.
